principle: Only real Windows/Neolith execution may mark a LIVE gate PASS. Static audits never substitute for live acceptance.
livePassed: two real accounts simultaneously logged in
canonical no-fight room rule consistently applied to two players addressing the same NPC
pendingLive: mutual player fight in a canonical combat-allowed room
single-owner ground-item contention using a real visible item
server restart persistence with both test characters offline before snapshot
guard relation when canonical level requirement is met
notes: The earlier NPC fight attempt in the inn proved room no_fight behavior, not actual combat start.
Arbitrary NPC `fight` is not assumed non-lethal because canonical fight.c may call kill_ob() for non-civilized NPCs.
currentReleaseNote: v3.19.3 adds a read-only content workbench, manual-review queue, dependency/triage views, and readiness-report fixes only; canonical gameplay and bridge implementation files are unchanged from the live-evidence baseline.
fingerprintNote: Fingerprints were captured from the implementing-code baseline that produced the recorded 2026-09-08 Windows/Neolith live evidence. Future tooling may mark evidence stale if an implementing file changes; freshness never creates a new PASS.
coverageNote: A stored fingerprint may exist for pending gates to establish a baseline, but only gates listed in coveredGateFingerprints have prior live evidence eligible to remain fresh.
